input.title: Game of Spades Bid Eau de Parfum 100ml for Men
input.descriptionHtml:
Game of Spades Bid is an eau de parfum for men from Jo Milano's Game of Spades collection, in the green Game of Spades bottle with a gold spade and knurled gold cap.

The scent has a fresh citrus opening, a spicy-woody heart and a warm amber base.

Details

  • Eau de parfum, 100ml spray
  • Made for men
  • Brand: Jo Milano (Game of Spades collection)
  • 100% authentic, dispatched from the UK

How to use

Spray from 15–20 cm onto pulse points such as the neck, inner wrists and inner elbows. Don't rub your wrists together. Patch test before first use if your skin is sensitive.

input.descriptionHtml:
Game of Spades Opal is an eau de parfum for men and women from Jo Milano's Game of Spades collection, in the white Game of Spades bottle with a crystal-set gold spade and gold cap.

The scent has bergamot, lemon, pear and raspberry on top, a heart of rose, jasmine and peony, and a base of amber, sandalwood, cedar and musk.

Details

  • Eau de parfum, 100ml spray
  • Unisex: for men and women
  • Brand: Jo Milano (Game of Spades collection)
  • 100% authentic, dispatched from the UK

How to use

Spray from 15–20 cm onto pulse points such as the neck, inner wrists and inner elbows. Don't rub your wrists together. Patch test before first use if your skin is sensitive.
